nodes.name: eda_auto_evolve.py
nodes.summary: EDA knowledge evolution driver: reads per-skill error_log.jsonl within a 7-day lookback window, counts error types via Counter, promotes any pattern hitting a threshold (default 3) into a memory/*.md file, syncs newly generated notes to the Tier-2 MEMORY.md index, and triggers signal matching on completion. Exposes skill_memory_dir, analyze_errors, detect_patterns, render_memory_md, sync_to_tier2, update_index, run_evolution, and _trigger_signal_match.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure Python 3 script using stdlib only (json, os, re, sys, collections.Counter, datetime, pathlib.Path). Procedural with module-level helpers; designed to be invoked as `python3 eda_auto_evolve.py <skill_name>`.

nodes.name: eda_memory_saver.py
nodes.summary: Appends classified error entries to a skill's memory/error_log.jsonl. Provides extract_error_lines, classify_error (categorizes by regex/keyword buckets), is_duplicate (dedup), save_error, _trigger_evolve (kicks off eda_auto_evolve.py), and a main entrypoint. Acts as the write-side counterpart to eda_auto_evolve.py.
nodes.languageNotes: Python 3 with stdlib only. No external dependencies; structured around small functions each handling one stage of the save/append pipeline.

nodes.name: signal_matcher.py
nodes.summary: Aggregates signals across skills by reading each skill's signal.jsonl, groups recurring patterns, and writes a Tier-2 signals.json plus promotion candidates (skills whose metrics suggest they should move up in the catalog). Functions: find_project_root, skills_dir, read_log, aggregate_signals, build_recommended, build_promotion_candidates, write_signals, main.
nodes.languageNotes: Python 3 stdlib-only. Walks the skills tree via pathlib and emits JSON summaries; no classes, just pure functions.

nodes.name: amp-copilot
nodes.summary: Skill specification for Amplifier Copilot — systematic amplifier design flow from spec capture through topology selection (25 amplifier topologies catalogued from Amplifier-Copilot), gm/Id lookup table characterization, transistor sizing, and PVT-corner simulation validation. Documented for OTA / opamp / comparator design across multiple process nodes.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with YAML frontmatter (name, description, allowed-tools). 23 sections including ASCII flow diagrams, topology tables, and structured JSON spec templates. English with some Chinese-language header annotations.

nodes.name: cell-explore
nodes.summary: Skill specification for browsing Cadence Virtuoso libraries, inspecting cellviews, and managing cells via the virtuoso-cli. Covers library listing, cellview inspection, cell management commands, and a key gotcha about virtuoso-cli vs raw SKILL behaviour.
nodes.languageNotes: Concise markdown doc (60 lines) with 5 sections; English with Chinese notes where helpful.

nodes.name: circuit-optimizer
nodes.summary: Skill specification for a Bayesian circuit optimizer. Step-by-step execution guide covering problem-definition JSON, gm/Id→W conversion, single-iteration simulation, and result scoring. Includes prerequisites and a 4-step loop suitable for amplifier and bias-circuit sizing sweeps.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with 15 sections; structured numbered steps with code blocks and JSON examples.

nodes.name: diag
nodes.summary: Skill specification for read-only diagnostics via `vcli diag cdslck <LIB>`. Documents the cds.lib lock-file detection workflow, what to do when a lock is held, implementation notes about why cdslck semantics matter, and a related window-dismiss-dialog command.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with 5 sections; English with embedded back-tick CLI snippets.

nodes.name: digital-import
nodes.summary: Skill specification for a 4-step digital import pipeline: import GDS via strmin, import Verilog via ihdl, add power labels, then restyle labels. Each step includes a verification check (e.g. confirming every expected cell/module landed) and detailed prerequisite notes about cds.lib DEFINE lines.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with 15 sections; long procedural walkthrough with embedded warning callouts and code blocks.

nodes.name: gm-over-id
nodes.summary: Skill specification for the gm/Id analog design methodology. Walks through deriving gm from specs, choosing gm/Id for the gain-bandwidth tradeoff, looking up Id and computing W, selecting L for gain vs speed, and automating the sweep with virtuoso-cli.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with 21 sections; English mixed with Chinese terminology for design concepts (e.g. 核心思想, 设计流程).

nodes.name: history-evolve
nodes.summary: Skill specification for evolving skill knowledge from CLI and SKILL execution history. Two-phase workflow: collect (load CLI history with noise filtering, load SKILL history for active sessions) and signal detection (hard failure exit_code != 0, SKILL nil return ok == false, correction patterns).
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with 15 sections; structured two-phase workflow with explicit signal taxonomy.

nodes.name: maestro-read-results
nodes.summary: Skill specification for reading Cadence Maestro/ADE output expression values directly from PSF binary files without a GUI or bridge. Documents the script entrypoint (scripts/read_results.py), argument routing, output JSON format, supported Ocean expression functions (getData, dB20, phaseDeg, bandwidth, ymax, VF, VT…), and PSF-tool troubleshooting.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with 7 sections; documents a 657-line Python script via embedded bash usage blocks and Ocean function table.

nodes.name: read_results.py
nodes.summary: CLI to parse maestro.sdb + active.state XML (with Cadence non-standard dialect tolerance), locate the active history run via history.sdb, invoke the cadence `psf` tool to ASCII-dump signals, and evaluate Ocean-style output expressions (getData, dB20, phaseDeg, bandwidth, ymax, VF, VT) returning structured JSON. Includes a Waveform class for arithmetic across scalar/waveform values.
nodes.languageNotes: Python 3 script with argparse CLI; stdlib + subprocess for psf invocation. Defines a `Waveform` class plus 16 functions including expression tokenizer/evaluator (ocean_to_python, eval_expression).

nodes.name: maestro
nodes.summary: Skill specification providing a quick-reference for Cadence Maestro (ADE Assembler). Documents the key difference between Explorer and Assembler modes, the typical flow, and three common failure modes (lock-file blocking edit mode, window stuck in Reading mode, maeAddOutput succeeding but maeGetResultOutputs returning nil).
nodes.languageNotes: Concise markdown (60 lines, 7 sections); Chinese terminology for cross-language support.

nodes.name: ocean-netlist-regen
nodes.summary: Skill specification explaining Ocean run() reliability and netlist regeneration pitfalls. Identifies three root causes (resultsDir change breaking run() being most common, sim setup disrupting active session, stale/missing netlist) and offers Solution A (restore resultsDir) and Solution B (direct Spectre invocation bypassing Ocean).
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with 14 sections; English narrative format with clearly demarcated Problem / Root Cause / Solution sections.

nodes.name: porting-skill
nodes.summary: Skill specification for PDK / process technology migration. Three-phase workflow: audit (catalog model file refs in Ocean/netlists, list active design variables, check Maestro corners), corner name mapping, and update model file paths across Ocean / ADE setup scripts.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with 14 sections; phased execution guide with explicit audit → map → update workflow.

nodes.name: schematic-gen
nodes.summary: Skill specification for schematic generation. Documents CLI commands, the JSON spec format consumed, the end-to-end workflow, and topology templates (5T OTA with PMOS diff pair + NMOS mirror load, PMOS-input folded-cascode OTA, two-stage Miller OTA).
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with 11 sections; embeds JSON spec samples and topology netlist templates.

nodes.name: sim-measure
nodes.summary: Skill specification for measuring simulation results. Covers DC operating-point, transient, AC, and noise measurements, enumerates available signal accessors and waveform math functions, and shows usage patterns for each analysis type.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with 9 sections; reference-style doc with tables of accessors and math functions.

nodes.name: sim-plot
nodes.summary: Skill specification for Matplotlib-based simulation visualization. Five chart-type recipes (parameter sweep line plot, corner-analysis grouped bar, scalar measurements horizontal bar, AC Bode plot, gm/Id lookup-table transistor curves) plus a common-workflows section.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with 12 sections; each chart type documented with usage block, parameters, and example output description.

nodes.name: plot_sim.py
nodes.summary: Matplotlib driver implementing the chart types documented in sim-plot/SKILL.md: detect_chart_type, plot_sweep (line), plot_corner (grouped bar), plot_measure (horizontal bar), plot_bode (AC magnitude/phase), plot_lookup (transistor curves), plus a _shorten label helper. CLI entrypoint parses JSON spec and dispatches.
nodes.languageNotes: Python 3 script; uses matplotlib. 8 functions including a chart-type autodetector and per-chart plotters.

nodes.name: sim-run
nodes.summary: Skill specification for running a Spectre simulation. Documents prerequisites, the run analysis invocation, the critical warning to NOT change resultsDir, success verification, key indicators in output, and common errors found in spectre.out.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with 7 sections; emphasizes the resultsDir invariant warning prominently.

nodes.name: sim-setup
nodes.summary: Skill specification for setting up simulations, covering prerequisites and the canonical setup steps prior to sim-run.
nodes.languageNotes: Short markdown doc (81 lines) with prerequisite and setup sections.

nodes.name: sim-sweep
nodes.summary: Skill specification for parameter sweeps across simulation analyses.
nodes.languageNotes: Short markdown doc (64 lines) focused on sweep usage.

nodes.name: skill-exec
nodes.summary: Skill specification for executing Skill (SKILL) language scripts inside Virtuoso sessions.
nodes.languageNotes: Concise markdown (48 lines) documenting SKILL script invocation.

nodes.name: skill-review
nodes.summary: Skill specification for reviewing and auditing skill definitions themselves (correctness, completeness, structure).
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown doc (94 lines) targeting skill-quality review workflow.

nodes.name: skill-shell-gotchas
nodes.summary: Skill specification documenting common shell pitfalls encountered while running skills (quoting, environment, path handling, exit-code propagation).
